title: Midday rollout triage — sprint echo
body:
Purpose:
Quick midday triage after the first canary wave for panel routing + instrumentation changes. Capture fast decisions, ownership, and immediate mitigation steps so we can revert or iterate before EOD.

Attendees:
- Sofia Martinez (notes/lead)
- Jared Kim (frontend)
- Priya Nair (backend/analytics)
- Lina Gomez (SRE)
- Aaron Blake (product)
- Observers: Emma T. (QA) stopped by for the last 15m

Context / summary:
- We rolled canary A (panel routing v2 + new telemetry hooks) at 09:00 PT to 5% of traffic.
- At 10:40 PT alerts fired: Canary failure rate increased and p95 UI render latency blipped.
- Baseline (pre-rollout): error-rate ~0.4% platform-wide for panel APIs. Canary at 5% showed 1.4% errors and p95 frontend latency +120ms on average for affected clients.
- Canary traces point to a mix of: a) extra DB lookups triggered by new telemetry enrichment, b) a degenerate client-side render path when analytics payload contains unexpected nulls.

Immediate decisions taken:
1) Pause new user assignment to canary cohort (stop expanding from 5%). Action: Lina to flip canary-assign flag. Target: 11:05 PT.
2) Revert telemetry enrichment flag for backend (server-side) while keeping client instrumentation live for debugging. Action: Priya to patch feature flag to server-only-off. Target: 11:20 PT.
3) Add defensive checks in frontend to short-circuit render when analytics blob has missing fields (temporary guard). Action: Jared to push urgent patch to PR #4821. Target: 12:00 PT (hotfix).

Detailed notes / evidence collected:
- Errors: stack traces show NPE in PanelRenderer.formatMetrics when payload.metrics is null. Example trace at 10:32:11.
- Backend traces: a subset of requests show an extra DB call (get_user_segment) invoked from telemetry enrichment path; cost ~40–60ms additional per request in worst cases.
- Analytics events: ingestion pipeline saw a sudden 6x increase in "panel.render.retry" events from canary cohort, correlating with error windows.
- Query used to validate: SELECT count(1) as c, avg(latency_ms) as p95 FROM ui_telemetry WHERE env='canary' AND event='panel.render' AND ts > '2026-12-22T09:00:00Z' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY ts DESC; (Priya will paste exact query in Slack thread).

Short-term mitigations (this afternoon):
- Hotfix frontend: defensive null handling + early return on missing metrics (Jared).
- Server flag rollback: disable enrichment that triggers DB lookups (Priya).
- Increase sampling for distributed traces in canary from 1% -> 25% for next 2 hours to gather richer traces (Lina).
- Run a focused synthetic suite against representative clients (QA) — Emma to run edge-case flows after hotfix lands.

Longer-term follow-ups (backlog items):
- RINF-2145: Replace synchronous DB lookup with async cache+fallback for telemetry enrichment (owner: Priya). ETA: sprint+1.
- UI: Harden PanelRenderer to tolerate partial telemetry payloads and add unit tests for missing-fields scenarios (owner: Jared). ETA: next sprint.
- Analytics: Add guardrails in ingestion that tag malformed payloads and drop heavy enrichment until validated (owner: Lina & Priya). ETA: 2 weeks.
- Add canary-specific synthetic checks (lens) for panel render success and end-to-end latency before expanding cohort (owner: Aaron). ETA: next planning cycle.

Open questions / unknowns:
- How many downstream customers hit the null-metrics path? We have a feeling it's concentrated to mobile SDK 3.2.1 — need targeted telemetry (Priya).
- Is the DB lookup used by any other critical path we didn't flag? Need a quick dependency audit (SRE + backend).

Action items (owner — due):
- Lina: Pause canary assignment (11:05 PT) — DONE.
- Priya: Rollback server enrichment flag and post canary trace summary to #slack-console-ops (11:20 PT) — IN_PROGRESS.
- Jared: Push frontend hotfix PR #4821, add test cases, and request QA (12:00 PT) — IN_PROGRESS.
- Emma: Run mobile-focused synthetic once hotfix merged and report regressions (13:30 PT) — PENDING.
- Aaron: Notify key customers in private channels that we're addressing a canary quality issue; provide ETA for safe expansion (EOD) — PENDING.
- Sofia: Collate meeting notes, attach traces and sample events to Confluence checklist; assign RINF-2145 (EOD) — PENDING.

Quick wins to consider for next rollouts:
- Add a light-weight contract test between frontend and telemetry payload shape to catch missing fields pre-rollout.
- Canary gating: require p95 not to regress >50ms and error-rate increase <0.5% for 30m before widening.
- Make the telemetry enrichment optional per-tenant via config so experiments can be scoped more narrowly.

Backchannel / links:
- Slack: #slack-console-ops thread (anchor message at 10:44 PT) — https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C0234ABCDEF/p1700000000000000
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4821
- Confluence checklist draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CON/rollout-checklist
- Traces: (attached in Confluence page — see section "Canary traces 2026-12-22")

Notes for retrospective:
- Consider a short dry-run of telemetry feature flips with traffic shadowing before user-facing canaries.
- Observability: ensure we have immediate dashboards for canary-specific error categories (not just total error-rate).

End of notes. If you were assigned something above, drop status updates in the Slack thread and update this doc with short markers (DONE / IN_PROGRESS / BLOCKED) so we can close before tomorrow morning standup.

Sofia Martinez
Lead — Console & Tooling
